Status report filed.

2.  By way of the present application, filed under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, (hereinafter referred to as 'the BNSS'), a prayer has been made to release the applicant, on interim bail, in case FIR No.96 of 2021, dated 21.12.2021, registered under Sections 363, and 376 of the Indian Penal Code 2 2024:HHC:6956 (hereinafter referred to as 'the IPC') and Section 6 of The Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (hereinafter referred to as the 'POCSO Act') with Police Station, Sangrah, District Sirmaur, H.P.
3.

1 4. As per the status report, the doctors/incharge of Surgery Unit-I, Dr. Y.S. Parmar, Government Medical College and Hospital Nahan, has given the report, as under:-
"Right Intrasphencteric Fistula in ano"
5.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Considering the said fact and the stage of the trial, according to which, the case is now fixed for final arguments, the application for interim bail is allowed, by releasing the applicant, on interim bail, 3 2024:HHC:6956 w.e.f. 15.8.2024 to 21.8.2024, in case FIR No. 96 of 2021, dated 21.12.2021,
under Sections 363, 376 IPC and Section 6 of POCSO Act, registered with Police Station, Sangrah,
District Sirmaur, on his furnishing personal bond, in the sum of Rs.50,000/-, with one surety, in the like amount, to the satisfaction of any duty Magistrate at Nahan.
It is further clarified that the bonds shall be furnished today itself and the applicant be released on 15.8.2024, in the morning.

. It is further clarified that the applicant shall surrender to the custody of Superintendent Jail,
Model Central Jail, Nahan, H.P., on 21.8.2024 by 5:00 p.m.
8.

Any of the observations, made herein above, shall not be taken, as an expression of opinion, on the merits of the case, as these observations are confined, only to the disposal of the present bail application.

9. The Registry is directed to forward a soft copy of the bail order to the Superintendent of the Model Central Jail, Nahan, through e-mail, with a direction to enter the date of grant of bail in the e- prison software.

10. Keeping in view the facts and circumstances of the case, if the applicant is not released within a period of three days from the date of grant of bail, then, the Superintendent of the Model 5 Decided On : 14.08.2024 vs State Of H.P on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/27116468/
2 2024:HHC:6956
Central Jail, Nahan, is directed to inform this fact to the Secretary, DLSA, Sirmaur at Nahan.
